text: I need the retained-unit inspector agreement study data, including the reference answers and every inspector judgement, to assess whether sound versus defective classifications are reliable.
I need the complete per-lot inspected and defective counts for the 25 consecutive lots, to assess whether the defective share has remained stable and compare it with the charter level.
I need the machine-by-machine tally of defective and sound units over the common inspection window, to locate where the defects are concentrated.
I need the reject categories tallied for the charter, including category counts, to identify the main defect cause.
I need the candidate failure modes and their risk ratings, including severity occurrence and detection or RPN values, to prioritize actions.
I need the inspected and defective counts for the one machine on both sides of the process change, with before and after labels, to quantify what the change achieved.
I need the monitoring record kept since the change, including the subgroup counts and any recorded signals, to determine how the improvement will be held.
One machine's inspected and defective counts either side of a change, before and after a change, for the change trial.
